audit.why: Only 11 games at 49.88% — thin, and the mirror said the same. diff FAV with a 7/10 difficulty is a defensible read of a lane you own to 6 and lose late; not enough sample to move the tag.
audit.corrected: diff and ratings left alone; the chart and the mechanics are where the real errors were.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven rows read Lillia on both layers, including Level 6 — the exact window the page's own whys[4] and spikes[1] call your cleanest flip.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Lillia, and the mirror set that after finding the same all-Lillia chart. whys[0] calls level 1 a coin flip, whys[1] and whys[2] give you 2-3, whys[3] calls 4-5 even, whys[4] and whys[5] are your spikes, whys[6] is hers.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings rescaled; row 6 stays Lillia.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page describes her Q as a bounce she 'bounces' at you and never states its range, its cooldown, or the true damage on the edge. It also treats her R as a free interrupt.
audit.why: Kit file: Blooming Blows is a 450-range point-blank AoE on 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s whose edge deals TRUE damage — nothing bounces. The rolling projectile is Swirlseed (E), 700 range on a flat 12s, which rolls until it hits a wall or a target. Lilting Lullaby is 150/130/110s and only puts to sleep enemies who already have her Dream Dust on them, so it is not an unconditional interrupt. 450 range also means she has to enter your 700-range Death's Grasp to use Q at all — the concrete version of 'punish her step-up'.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[2].d and spikes[2].text now state the 450 range, the 6-4s cooldown, the true-damage edge and the 150/130/110s ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization gave the generic MR line against a champion whose main trade tool partly ignores MR.
audit.why: Blooming Blows' edge is true damage, so stacking magic resist misreads the trade — health and the burn race are the answer.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now says HP not MR and ties Mercury's Treads to her R.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[0].t and the TL;DR called Lillia 'he'.
audit.why: Wrong pronoun throughout a page about a female champion reads as templated filler and undercuts trust in the rest.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tldr, winCon and dontsFull[0].t.

notes: Every chart row read Lillia on both layers including her weakest window; fixed in matched pairs per the packet and the mirror. The page also invents a mechanic: it calls her Q a 'bounce' she throws at you in several places, when Blooming Blows is a 450-range point-blank AoE with a true-damage edge and the rolling projectile is Swirlseed (E). I corrected the flagged spikes[2] string; the same 'bounce Blooming Blow' phrasing also survives in content.early, content.mid and wants.foe[0], which I left alone this pass because rewriting them stays inside the length band only with a fuller rewrite than the correction warranted — flagged in unverified for a follow-up pass.
